result.instructions: Tools for Betterworks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which goals on our team are at risk this quarter?"; "Show me the recognitions given to Maria in the last 30 days."; "Create a goal for Sam called Reduce onboarding time, due 2027-03-31.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Betterworks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run betterworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run betterworks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run betterworks_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. betterworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: betterworks_list_goals
tools.title: List goals
tools.description: List goals (objectives) with filters for owner, group, category, visibility, risk and last update. Returns owner, progress and dates. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/goals/filter/.

owner.description: Only goals owned by this user id.

aligned_to_owner.description: Only goals aligned to goals of this user id.

aligned_to_goal.description: Only goals aligned to this goal id.

group.description: Only goals of this department (group) id.

category.description: Only goals in this category id.

risk.description: Risk filter, as the vendor documents it (for example at_risk).

updated_since.description: Only goals updated on or after this date.

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_search_goals
tools.title: Search goals by name
tools.description: Search goals by name (q, at least 3 characters) and by timing: current, future, not_due or goal_type. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/goals/search/.

q.description: Part of the goal name (at least 3 characters).

current.description: Only goals that are active now.

current_stale.description: Only goals active now or ended within 7 days.

future.description: Only goals that have not started yet.

not_due.description: Only goals that have not ended yet.

goal_type.description: Goal type, as the vendor documents it.

visibility.description: public, private or locked (locked shows limited goals).

tools.name: betterworks_get_goal
tools.title: Get a goal
tools.description: Get one goal with its owner, dates, progress, milestones (children), categories and last check-in. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/goals/{goal_id}/.

goal_id.description: The goal id (from betterworks_list_goals or betterworks_search_goals).

tools.name: betterworks_list_goal_comments
tools.title: List goal comments
tools.description: List the comments on one goal. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/goals/{goal_id}/comments/.

goal_id.description: The id as returned by another tool.

tools.name: betterworks_list_goal_assessments
tools.title: List goal assessments
tools.description: List the assessments recorded for one goal. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/goals/{goal_id}/assessments/.

goal_id.description: The id as returned by another tool.

tools.name: betterworks_search_goal_categories
tools.title: Search goal categories
tools.description: Find goal category ids by name, for use in betterworks_list_goals or betterworks_create_goal. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/goals/categories/search/.

tools.name: betterworks_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees with department, manager, title and active status. Filters: department, employee_id, manager_id, locale, deactivated, delta dates. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/users/.

manager_id.description: Only direct reports of this manager user id.

deactivated.description: 0 for active users, 1 for deactivated users.

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one employee profile: name, email, title, manager, department, roles, custom values and attributes. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}/.

user_id.description: The user id (from betterworks_list_users or betterworks_search_users).

tools.name: betterworks_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Find employees whose full name or email matches q. Optional: manager_id, deactivated, and can_view_goal_id to mark who can see a goal. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/users/search/.

q.description: Part of the full name or the email.

manager_id.description: Only users who report to this manager user id.

can_view_goal_id.description: Mark each user who can view this goal id.

tools.name: betterworks_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams, optionally by type and including deactivated teams. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/teams/.

type.description: Team type, as the vendor documents it.

include_deactivated.description: Include deactivated teams (the vendor default is true).

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_get_team
tools.title: Get a team
tools.description: Get one team by id. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/teams/{team_id}/.

team_id.description: The id as returned by another tool.

tools.name: betterworks_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List departments (groups), optionally including deactivated ones. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/departments/.

tools.name: betterworks_list_admin_groups
tools.title: List admin groups
tools.description: List admin groups that control who can manage which users and goals. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/groups/.

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: List the roles that can be assigned to users. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/roles/.

tools.name: betterworks_list_recognitions
tools.title: List recognitions
tools.description: List recognitions (kudos) with filters for a user, a group, a hashtag or a date range. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/recognitions/.

end_date.description: End of the date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with start_date.

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_list_feedback
tools.title: List feedback
tools.description: List feedback given to users, optionally for one user or one cycle. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/feedback/.

for_user_id.description: Feedback received by this user id.

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_list_feedback_requests
tools.title: List feedback requests
tools.description: List feedback requests sent to or from users, with open or declined state. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/feedback/requests/.

from_user.description: Requests sent by this user id.

tools.name: betterworks_list_hashtags
tools.title: List hashtags
tools.description: List the hashtags used in recognitions and goals. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/hashtags/.

delta_start.description: Only items modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

delta_end.description: Only items modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_list_report_runs
tools.title: List report runs
tools.description: List report runs with their template, report name and creation date. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/report_runs/.

created.description: Only runs created on this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: betterworks_get_report_run
tools.title: Get a report run
tools.description: Get one report run: its status and, when finished, its result. Betterworks API: GET /api/v1/report_runs/{report_run_id}/.

tools.name: betterworks_create_goal
tools.title: Create a goal
tools.description: CREATES a goal owned by one user, with dates, visibility and a progress type. Changes Betterworks data. Betterworks API: POST /api/v1/goals/.

owner_user_id.description: User id of the goal owner.

parent.description: Parent goal UUID (aligns this goal to it).

tools.name: betterworks_update_goal
tools.title: Update a goal
tools.description: CHANGES an existing goal. Send only the fields to change; the request body holds those fields only. Betterworks API: PUT /api/v1/goals/{goal_id}/.

tools.name: betterworks_post_goal_checkin
tools.title: Check in on a goal
tools.description: POSTS a check-in on a goal or milestone: a new progress value (metric) or a done state (binary). Changes Betterworks data. Betterworks API: POST /api/v1/goals/{goal_id}/checkin/.

goal_id.description: The goal or milestone id to check in on.

value.description: New current progress on the metric milestone.

done.description: New completion state for a binary milestone (send false for a metric milestone).

tools.name: betterworks_create_report_run
tools.title: Start a report run
tools.description: STARTS a report run for a date range (for example all_goals, feedback_adoption or recognition). It runs on the vendor side; read the result with betterworks_get_report_run. Betterworks API: POST /api/v1/report_runs/.

report.description: Report to run. conversation_answers and feedback_answers need super admin or HR admin rights.

template.description: Template id. Required for conversation and feedback reports.
